facts.fact: ZPPA acting director-general Justin Matimuna said 14,732 tenders from 431 procuring entities were published on the E-GP system in the third quarter of 2024.
ZPPA said use of the E-GP system is mandated under Section 16 of the Public Procurement Act and directed that all public procurement be conducted exclusively on the platform.
